name: 05 - SMS Inbox: Batch SMS modal opens with textarea and submit button
description: Verifies the batch SMS modal opens correctly and allows entering text and submitting for matching

planSteps.description: Log in with username 'admin' and password 'admin123'
Verify dashboard is displayed with statistics cards
Click on the SMS inbox sidebar link (رسائل الـ SMS والسداد)
Verify SMS inbox page is shown with a header containing 'رسائل الـ SMS'
Click the button labeled 'استقبال دفعي لعدة رسائل' to open the batch SMS modal
Verify a modal dialog appears with a textarea field for entering SMS messages
Type the following text into the textarea: 'Vodafone Cash: استلام مبلغ: 300.00 جنيه من 01001234501 رقم العملية: VF48200001'
Verify the submit button 'استقبال ومطابقة آلية' is now enabled
Click the submit button 'استقبال ومطابقة آلية'
Verify the modal closes after submission
Verify at least one SMS message row appears in the inbox list
